scope: Finite synthetic structural pipeline selection and Components-to-Composite packaging; not Langflow execution or a complete Paper 2 controller
baseline: ungated-first selects the first named-capability candidate; it uses repaired packaging but skips candidate type/locality gates. Common profile, ambiguity, budget and cycle guards remain. All methods see the same descriptions and candidate order.
v0: typed and constraint-gated bounded candidate selection; packaging exposes crossing edges but omits required unbound inputs. Configuration/dependency references are retained.
v1: v0 plus required unbound input exposure; one planned packaging correction.
exposure: All cases and methods authored by the same AI assistant in one session; evaluation cases are designated evaluation, not independently held out. No statistical generalization claim.
revision: v0 and the proposed v1 correction are frozen together before execution; this is a planned defect/correction demonstration, not a revision discovered blindly from observations

decision_criteria.conformance: zero accepted-artifact violations among the explicit oracle checks for a method to pass this bounded suite
decision_criteria.case_pass: expected outcome matches; composite artifacts additionally pass independent structural oracle
decision_criteria.gap: expected gap kind matches, not merely any non-success outcome
decision_criteria.comparison: paired descriptive case counts and attempts; no significance test, no model-cost or latency claim

limits: default 8 examined candidates; exact per-case overrides recorded; finite authored candidate domain; no recursive decomposition, branch backtracking, behavioral inference or generated primitive implementation

hypotheses.H1: partial examination within finite candidate grammar
hypotheses.H2: partial examination of explicit structural gaps
hypotheses.H3: comparison only to weak ungated selector; no strong baseline superiority claim
hypotheses.H4: planned correction with exposed same-author evaluation, not independent evidence of generalization

execution: pure local Python specification generation and assertions; no models, remote tools, Langflow runtime or deployment
